mapper.select: SELECT A.ACM_ID acm_id, A.ACM_NAME acm_name, A.DETAIL_ADDRESS detail_address, A.MAIN_IMG main_img, A.ACM_TYPE_ID acm_type_id, MIN(R.PRICE) AS price, MIN(R.DISCOUNT_PRICE) AS discountPrice FROM ACCOMMODATION A JOIN ROOM R ON A.ACM_ID = R.ACM_ID WHERE A.ACM_TYPE_ID = #{ACM_TYPE_ID} GROUP BY A.ACM_ID, A.ACM_NAME, A.DETAIL_ADDRESS, A.MAIN_IMG, A.ACM_TYPE_ID
SELECT A.ACM_ID ACM_ID, AVG(R.RATING) AS RATING, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS REVIEWCNT FROM ACCOMMODATION A LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON A.ACM_ID = R.ACM_ID WHERE A.ACM_ID = #{ACM_ID} GROUP BY A.ACM_ID

SELECT A.ACM_ID AS acm_id, TO_CHAR(A.ACM_NAME) AS acm_name, A.DETAIL_ADDRESS AS detail_address, A.MAIN_IMG AS main_img, A.ACM_TYPE_ID AS acm_type_id, MIN(R.PRICE) AS price, MIN(R.DISCOUNT_PRICE) AS discountPrice FROM ACCOMMODATION A JOIN ROOM R ON A.ACM_ID = R.ACM_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND TO_CHAR(A.ACM_NAME) LIKE '%' || #{keyWord} || '%'
AND (#{numberPeople} IS NULL OR #{numberPeople} <= 0 OR R.MAX_PERSON >= #{numberPeople})
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RESERVATION RES WHERE RES.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND ( (#{startDate} >= RES.CHECK_IN_DATE AND #{startDate} < RES.CHECK_OUT_DATE) OR (#{finishDate} > RES.CHECK_IN_DATE AND #{finishDate} <= RES.CHECK_OUT_DATE) OR (#{startDate} <= RES.CHECK_IN_DATE AND #{finishDate} >= RES.CHECK_OUT_DATE) ) )
GROUP BY A.ACM_ID, A.ACM_NAME, A.DETAIL_ADDRESS, A.MAIN_IMG, A.ACM_TYPE_ID
SELECT ACM_TYPE_ID, ACM_TYPE FROM ACCOMMODATION_TYPE WHERE ACM_TYPE_ID = #{acm_type_id}
